name: Henry I the Admirable
note: joint reign of the sons of Albert I; 1291 division: Henry received Grubenhagen

name: Albert II the Fat
note: joint reign; 1291 division: Albert took Göttingen

name: William I
note: joint reign; 1291 division: William received Brunswick

name: Otto the Mild
note: after Albert's death his sons Otto, Ernest and Magnus divided the princedom; Otto died without issue 1344

name: Ernest
note: co-ruler (division among Albert's sons); after 1344 Ernest and Magnus divided the estate

name: Magnus Torquatus
note: Lüneburg War of Succession began under him

name: Frederick
note: murdered near Fritzlar 1400; joint rule by Bernard and Henry followed

name: Henry the Mild
note: founded the Middle House of Brunswick; co-ruler with Bernard

name: Bernard
note: co-ruler; inherited Lüneburg and founded the House of Hanover

name: Frederick Ulrich
note: Wolfenbüttel line of the Middle House died out 1634; title transferred to the New House of Brunswick

name: Anthony Ulrich
note: co-ruler with Rudolf Augustus from 1685 (overlapping dates in source)

name: Louis Rudolph
note: Wolfenbüttel line died out; title transferred to Brunswick-Bevern

name: Charles II William Ferdinand
note: died after the Battle of Jena

name: Frederick William
note: 1807-1813 occupied by the French (Kingdom of Westphalia); in 1814 reformed as the Duchy of Brunswick; Duchy of Brunswick page names him first duke but gives no dates

name: Charles II
note: Duchy of Brunswick; son of Frederick William; forced to flee in 1830

name: William VIII
note: brother of Charles II; last of the Brunswick line
